scientific_limitations: Only truncation length N=5 is proved; computational exact polynomial positivity of degree 50411 is an essential proof ingredient. No assertion for all N congruent to 1 or 2 modulo 4.
title: Strict positivity of the five-term truncation in the two-block odd partition conjecture
